name: From the low feral charging crouch, snap both boxing gloves
prompt: From the low feral charging crouch, snap both boxing gloves together in front of the chest, then violently thrust BOTH arms straight forward to the right simultaneously. Feet stay firmly planted. Lean the torso forward and snarl with fierce exertion, hold both gloves fully extended, shoulders shaking from the force, then recoil slightly. Flames whip backward off the gloves and boots as he thrusts. No transformation, no spinning, no uppercut, no alternating punches. Fixed camera and consistent body proportions.
